technology_name: A METHOD FOR SYNTHESIS OF BIO-SOURCED EPOXY VITRIMER FOR ENHANCED TOUGHNESS AND RECYCLABILITY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard industrial epoxy resins are completely unrecyclable cross-linked networks that suffer from brittle mechanical fractures and generate substantial landfill overhead.
description: An eco-friendly material synthesis method that replaces petrochemical monomers with sustainable bio-sourced alternatives to build an advanced epoxy vitrimer network utilizing dynamic covalent bond exchanges.
applications: Recyclable aerospace composites, eco-friendly automotive body panels, sustainable consumer electronics casings, and high-toughness industrial coatings.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
